tasks.title: Fold derives planned vs found per task: planned = in the latest plan_updated or added before any task status change; found = added after work began. Derived from the log, no new event field, so existing records get it unchanged

Status line: pie and fraction measure the plan (◔ slug 3/13), with (N left) appended only when found work is open — a record with no found work renders byte-identically. TypeScript and Rust core both, facts cache version bumped
sofar status / digest: one line breaking down plan done/total, found open/done, pending/active/blocked, dropped
SPEC updated for planned/found and the new status-line shape; conformance passes on TS and Rust
Optional parent on task_added: a follow-up names the task it came from and renders under it, not as a top-level task (schema change, decision first)
Write-back wording: a follow-up names its parent; a ruling the operator must make is a decision, not a task
Rulings surface as 'needs your call' rather than counting as tasks
When the planned scope is all resolved, sofar says so and offers to close the stage, carrying open follow-ups into the next record
